name: Armor kit
desc: Patches your armor: most of a Common set, less of a finer one. You are open and slow while you repair.

channel.src: repair: one press restores 80/40/30% on the first three armor grades, stack 8, slot 2 is the repair's (docs/SOURCE_UTILITIES.md). Time and speed: none, the wiki only says a short cast; ours, kept until footage gives numbers. See docs/CONSUMABLES.md
